tldr: The Moon through the 1st house sensitizes your body, identity, confidence, and first response to life.
body:
When the Moon moves through your 1st house, it makes you more sensitive to your body, identity, energy, appearance, confidence, and the way you show up. You may feel more aware of how you are coming across, how much energy you have, and whether your outer life still matches who you feel yourself becoming.

A need, mood, habit, or private reaction may become harder to ignore. It can help you read what you need before the feeling gets louder.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for noticing what your presence is already saying before you explain anything.

The caution: Watch for treating a temporary mood as the whole truth. The risk is becoming too focused on how you are perceived and missing what your body is telling you.

The Moon moves through this house for a few days. Treat the feeling as information. Give it a grounded place to land before you react from it.
